output.question: 只返回有效订单数这一列，不要分组。

draft.explanation: 有效订单数按 clean_orders 中的订单行数统计（clean_orders 已剔除异常订单），不分城市、商品或时间。
assumptions: “有效订单”指 clean_orders 中的记录，即已通过异常过滤的订单行
按订单行（row_id）计数，而非去重 order_id

result.sql: SELECT count(*) AS valid_order_count FROM clean_orders

draft.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_cents)/100.0, 2) AS total_amount_yuan FROM clean_orders
draft.explanation: 使用 clean_orders 对全部有效订单的 amount_cents 求和后除以100.0转为元，不扣退款。
assumptions: clean_orders 已剔除异常订单，代表有效订单

result.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_cents)/100.0, 2) AS total_amount_yuan FROM clean_orders

cases.question: 只返回所有有效订单扣除有效退款后的净额，单位元，一列。

output.question: 只返回所有有效订单扣除有效退款后的净额，单位元，一列。

draft.sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0) FROM clean_orders) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_cents),0) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents FROM clean_refunds WHERE refund_cents > 0 GROUP BY order_id)), 2) / 100.0 AS net_amount
draft.explanation: 商品总额取 clean_orders 全部有效订单的 amount_cents 求和；有效退款先按 order_id 聚合 clean_refunds 中正退款额，再整体求和；两者相减后除以100.0得到元。
assumptions: clean_orders 已剔除异常订单，clean_refunds 已剔除异常退款
有效退款指 refund_cents > 0 的退款
净额不扣除非退款类调整，且无成本数据

result.sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0) FROM clean_orders) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_cents),0) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents FROM clean_refunds WHERE refund_cents > 0 GROUP BY order_id)), 2) / 100.0 AS net_amount

cases.question: 按门店ID升序返回门店名称、有效订单数、商品总额（元）、有效退款额（元），共四列。

output.question: 按门店ID升序返回门店名称、有效订单数、商品总额（元）、有效退款额（元），共四列。

draft.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) AS valid_order_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(co.amount_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS gross_amount_yuan, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cr.refund_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS valid_refund_yuan FROM stores s LEFT JOIN clean_orders co ON co.store_id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents FROM clean_refunds WHERE refund_cents > 0 GROUP BY order_id) cr ON cr.order_id = co.order_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY s.store_id ASC
draft.explanation: 以 stores 为主表左连接 clean_orders 统计有效订单数与商品总额（分求和后除100.0）；退款先按 order_id 聚合且仅取正退款额，再 JOIN，避免放大订单数和金额；净额不在此列。
assumptions: 有效订单指 clean_orders 中的订单（已剔除异常）
有效退款指 clean_refunds 中 refund_cents>0 的退款

result.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) AS valid_order_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(co.amount_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS gross_amount_yuan, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cr.refund_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS valid_refund_yuan FROM stores s LEFT JOIN clean_orders co ON co.store_id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents FROM clean_refunds WHERE refund_cents > 0 GROUP BY order_id) cr ON cr.order_id = co.order_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY s.store_id ASC
